rootCause: The worker image was absent. The systemd service mounts /root read-only, but Docker Buildx tried to write /root/.docker/buildx/activity. Automatic build stderr was discarded.

before.error: failed to update builder last activity time: read-only file system

after.change: Disposable writable DOCKER_CONFIG outside the build context; systemd restrictions retained.

covers: image recovery readiness and concurrent build
HTTP 503 before job creation when worker unavailable
multipart retries and failed delivery acknowledgements
retention after five failed text sends

limits: Two real worker runs of one public research question, with synthetic Discord IDs and no live Discord sends. This validates this incident and complete delivery; it is not an overall factual-accuracy score or a latency benchmark.
